verdict.rationale: Text extracted from the GST help pages (gst.gov.in/help/helpmodules and /help/registration) suggests their guidance content is served as readable HTML. A probe of the companion income-tax portal also contrasts that site's JS-only shell with 'the GST portal's readable pages.' However, no direct probe of the GST site exists with a keyless, identified-user-agent request that records status codes or confirms no CAPTCHA or bot wall, so coverage is only partial. missing for 10: a direct keyless GET probe of GST guidance pages with an identified user agent, explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot wall exists, confirmation that content is not JS-rendered across the full guidance surface (including manuals and FAQs), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: the companion direct-tax portal serves a JavaScript application shell with no keyless HTML content, unlike the GST portal's readable pages
